comment: How Copilot CLI runs a seat. The role comes from policy/library.json (lane -> role); each library role runs as the custom agent of the same name unless `agents` maps it to another; generated roles run as `fallback.agent` with their charter in the prompt. Tool flags come from the seat's catalog permissions through `tools`; a seat without a write permission also gets --deny-tool write. Tool names and model names are placeholders: check them against your CLI version and the models your Copilot plan offers. `lanes` applies only when the policy has no team.
